entities.name: Gorex
entities.description: Massive zombie turtle of Nephalia, reanimated by Jadar as a beast of burden.

entities.name: Jadar
entities.description: Nephalia's foremost ghoulcaller who reanimated the turtle.

entities.name: Morkrut marsh
entities.description: Marsh where Jadar dredged corpses and found the turtle.

events.summary: Jadar finds a massive turtle corpse in the marsh, enlarges it with magic, and reanimates it as his cart and horse.
events.quote: A little magic made it even larger, and then a lot of magic reanimated it

relations.quote: A little magic made it even larger
it now serves as Jadar's primary means of transport.
